summary: This work improves how Firefox handles page navigation, security, and web standards: it updates prefetching based on links and user intent, tightens checks around content and policy headers, and renames Feature Policy to Permissions Policy. It also fills out CSS Typed OM transform features, improves canvas and form-control cleanup, and updates speech recognition and other browser APIs. Together, these changes make page behavior more predictable while bringing Firefox closer to current web standards.
